milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the birch stairs (placed at spawn-relative ~4,~0,~4 through ~4,~0,~6) and face toward them, modeling 'player can see the target'. Target is set to the center birch_stairs block at (4, 0, 5). Max distance 16 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the stairs.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted wooden_hoe ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no wooden_hoe, so any wooden_hoe in inventory confirms successful crafting. Recipe: 2 oak_planks + 2 sticks on a crafting table. Player has 16 oak_planks and 4 sticks — more than sufficient.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted oak_stairs end up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_stairs, and the scene only contains birch_stairs (not oak_stairs), so there is zero false-positive risk from picking up placed blocks. Recipe: 6 oak_planks → 4 oak_stairs. After crafting the hoe, 14 planks remain — more than enough. Min_count is 1 (recipe yields 4).
